items.title: Batman’s bike could be yours, if you have a spare $1.2 million
items.brief: Batman’s motorbike, known as the Batpod, is going under the hammer as part of a movie memorabilia auction, with an estimate of up to £900,000 ($1.2 million).

items.title: Musk bet big on keeping Texas red. What happens to his business empire now?
items.brief: Elon Musk poured nearly half a billion dollars into the midterms to support Republican candidates, most to help Ken Paxton defeat Democrat James Talarico in the Texas Senate race.

items.title: Indiana carries out the first of 3 US executions taking place on a single day
items.brief: An Indiana man who admitted to killing his girlfriend’s two children was executed early Thursday in the first of three lethal injections scheduled for the same day in the US.

items.title: Water rescues, evacuations underway as ‘catastrophic flood event’ hits North Georgia and southern Tennessee
items.brief: Homes are flooded and water rescues and evacuations are in progress as flash flood emergencies — the highest level of flood warning — impact North Georgia and southern Tennessee.

items.title: Escaped killer drank beer, made garlic bread and apologized in writing before capture
items.brief: Authorities on Wednesday were still trying to piece together how an escaped Tennessee prisoner convicted of murder evaded capture for more than a week before being tracked down hundreds of miles away in Missouri.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international soccer after a record-breaking career with Portugal
items.brief: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international soccer after a record-breaking career with Portugal.

items.title: Republicans quickly turn against Pete Hegseth after midterms rout
items.brief: President Donald Trump may have made the decision to launch the war that tanked voters’ support for the GOP and dealt them a midterm shellacking.

items.title: Bob the poet, meet Bob the priest: Pope Leo receives Bob Dylan at the Vatican
items.brief: They are two of the world’s best-known Bobs from the US Midwest.
